name: tiberius-succeeds-augustus
description: The stepson and adopted heir of the first emperor took the throne, showing power could pass within one family.

name: claudius-raised-by-praetorians
description: Soldiers of the Praetorian Guard found the dead ruler's hiding uncle and proclaim him emperor, an unlikely scholar on the throne.

name: vespasian-proclaimed-emperor
description: A general commanding in the East won the civil war and the throne, founding the Flavian dynasty.

name: titus-becomes-emperor
description: The conqueror of Jerusalem succeeded his father Vespasian and ruled briefly, remembered as a gentle and popular emperor.

name: commodus-becomes-emperor
description: The philosopher-emperor's son inherited the throne, a ruler later portrayed as a gladiator-obsessed tyrant.

name: septimius-severus-seizes-throne
description: An African-born general marched on Rome and defeated rivals to win the throne, founding the Severan dynasty.

name: caracalla-sole-emperor
description: After his father's death and the murder of his brother, Caracalla took sole power over the empire.

name: elagabalus-becomes-emperor
description: A teenage priest of a Syrian sun god was proclaimed emperor by the troops, soon scandalising Rome.

name: aurelian-becomes-emperor
description: A tough soldier-emperor took the throne amid crisis and went on to reunify the fractured empire.

name: diocletian-becomes-emperor
description: A soldier of humble origins was hailed emperor and later divided rule among four men to steady the realm.

name: constantine-hailed-emperor
description: Troops at York proclaimed Constantine emperor after his father died, the start of the first Christian emperor's rise.

name: julian-apostate-sole-emperor
description: Julian became sole emperor on his cousin's death and tried to turn the empire back to the old gods.

name: theodosius-i-becomes-emperor
description: A Spanish-born general was named emperor in the East after a disastrous defeat by the Goths.

name: romulus-augustulus-emperor
description: A boy was set on the western throne by his general father, destined to be the last emperor of Rome in the West.

name: heraclius-becomes-emperor
description: The son of Africa's governor sailed from Carthage, overthrew a tyrant and took Constantinople's throne, then fought Persia and the Arabs.

name: leo-iii-becomes-emperor
description: A soldier from Syria seized the Byzantine throne as Arab fleets approached, founding a new dynasty.

name: irene-sole-ruler-byzantium
description: After blinding her own son, Irene ruled the Byzantine Empire in her own name, a woman holding the imperial title.

name: basil-i-founds-macedonian-dynasty
description: A peasant-born courtier murdered his patron and took the Byzantine throne, founding a dynasty that led its golden age.

name: basil-ii-becomes-emperor
description: The future "Bulgar-Slayer" became senior emperor on the death of John Tzimiskes, soon to expand the empire to a medieval peak.

name: alexios-komnenos-seizes-power
description: A veteran general took Constantinople by force, restoring a battered empire and later calling for Western help.

name: michael-viii-palaiologos-crowned
description: A nobleman had himself crowned co-emperor of the Greek exiles in Anatolia, soon to retake Constantinople.

name: constantine-xi-last-emperor
description: The final Byzantine emperor took the throne of a city-state ringed by Ottoman power.
